ideas.pitch: An offline AI-powered code reviewer running locally on client hardware to catch security anti-patterns before commits.
ideas.title: LocalDev Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact technical architecture of DevMesh which won 2nd place at the Qualcomm Snapdragon Multiverse Hackathon, appealing to judges looking for high-performance edge AI tooling.

ideas.pitch: An engineering lifecycle intelligence platform that ingests repository activity and pull requests to automatically build searchable team knowledge graphs for new hires.
ideas.title: OnboardFlow AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly replicates the winning pattern of devflow by solving a painful developer onboarding bottleneck that hackathon judges experience firsthand.

ideas.pitch: A training-free, self-improving semantic router using kNN over an exemplar index to dynamically route user queries to the cheapest and most accurate LLM endpoint.
ideas.title: SemanticRouter Hub
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-performance architecture of darwin-router, offering judges immediate cost-saving utility for production AI systems.

ideas.pitch: A visual BPMN-orchestrated pre-deployment risk diagnosis tool that validates multi-agent AI execution paths and catches compliance violations.
ideas.title: AgentWorkflow BPMN Guard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the prize-winning methodology of fde-agent-uipath, focusing heavily on enterprise AI governance and risk management which impresses technical judges.

ideas.pitch: A zero-config auto-embedding and RAG toolkit tailored natively for MariaDB to instantly transform database documentation into a searchable context engine.
ideas.title: AutoRAG MariaDB Toolkit
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the successful recipe of seamless-rag, targeting database developers with a turnkey utility that solves a common data retrieval pain point.
